question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following number series ?

26, 28, 24, 30, 22, ?
solution:
**Given series:** 26, 28, 24, 30, 22, **?**

The logic followed here is: 

 
• An even number is added then the next consecutive even number is subtracted from the next term.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a2ea9d48f37037f14fbd7ec7049df80ac507dae2eb34297ddcd3f79e0459190.png] 

Hence, the correct answer will be **32.**
